newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close lower after upbeat start.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close lower after upbeat start.

text.p: Swedish shares fell back on Wednesday after an optimistic start. An Astra-led rally in the morning was wiped out as the index-heavy banking and engineering sectors posted losses later in the session.
The all-share index fell 0.33 percent to 2,079.15 after touching an intra-day high of 2,097.48. Turnover was very brisk at 5.39 billion crowns.

Drugs group Astra closed just two crowns higher at 288.50 after touching 292 crowns in the morning. Dealers said positive analyses from a number of brokerages were behind the early strength. The share posted strong gains in New York overnight.
Engineering group ABB made strong gains after the $5.5 billion Bakun dam project in Malaysia was finalised.
The ABB share closed 12 crowns higher at 726.

Banks were among the day's main losers despite a sharp fall in bond yields. S-E-Banken fell two crowns to 55, and Handelsbanken lost one to 165 crowns but Nordbanken bucked the trend to gain two crowns to 170.
Autoliv, which rocketed to 310 crowns on Monday on the announcement of a merger with the airbag operations of U.S. Morton International, slid 14 crowns to 272.
Among the blue-chips, Ericsson fell 2.50 to 167.50 crowns, and Volvo fell 2.50 crowns to 142.
